sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Serous exudation into the tympanitic cavities.
Tinnitus. [Pilocarpin 2x.]

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Saliva viscid, like white of egg. Dryness.
Free salivation, with profuse siveating.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Nausea on looking at objects moving;
vomiting; pressure and pain in .stomach.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Diarrhoea, painless ; during day with
flushed face and profuse sweat.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text: Scanty ; paih over pubes with much urging.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Bronchial mucous membrane inflamed.
Much inclination to cough and difficult breathing.
CEdema of lungs. Foamy sputa. Profuse, thin, serous
expectoration. Slow, sighing respiration.
